basic_info.description: SUBMIT OFFERS by Thursday at 5PM to this wonderfully versatile home located at 419 Felton Street, nestled in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Offering both comfort and convenience, this property boasts a fantastic location with easy access to public transportation, including nearby Muni bus lines and the 24th Street BART station, providing an easy commute to downtown and beyond.  The upstairs has a spacious layout that features 3 well-appointed bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, it showcases a bright and airy family/living room and dining room perfect for gatherings. The kitchen is equipped with ample storage and counter space, making it ideal for home cooking and entertaining.  Downstairs, the opportunities are endless with a generously-sized garage that offers plenty of space for parking for 3 cars and storage. Additionally, the lower level includes a separate 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom space with its own fully permitted kitchenperfect for guests or extended family.  This home offers a perfect blend of style, functionality, and potential. Whether you're looking for a multi-generational home or a space for future expansion,419 Felton Street is full of possibilities. Don't miss the chance to call it your own.
